Package neqsim.process.safety.release

Class SourceTermFrame

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.safety.release.SourceTermFrame
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class SourceTermFrame extends Object implements Serializable
Self-contained versioned safety-source frame. JSON contains explicit SI units, diagnostic failures and deterministic ordering. No external simulator is needed.

  • Method Details

    • calculated

      public static SourceTermFrame calculated(String scenarioId, String sourceId, UUID calculationId, long sequence, double simulationTimeS, Instant generatedAt, ReleaseFlowRequest request, ReleaseFlowResult result, Map<String,String> provenance)
      Creates a frame from a release result. Invalid results contain no numeric source payload.
      Parameters:
      scenarioId - stable scenario identity
      sourceId - stable release-source identity
      calculationId - frame or session calculation UUID
      sequence - monotonically increasing sequence within a session
      simulationTimeS - simulation time in s
      generatedAt - UTC generation instant
      request - release geometry and thermodynamic-model provenance
      result - release result
      provenance - additional stable source/process metadata
      Returns:
      immutable frame

    • unavailable

      public static SourceTermFrame unavailable(String scenarioId, String sourceId, UUID calculationId, long sequence, double simulationTimeS, Instant generatedAt, SourceTermFrame.Status status, String code, String message, Map<String,String> provenance)
      Creates a process failure/stale/disabled frame without reusing previous source quantities.
      Parameters:
      scenarioId - scenario identity
      sourceId - release-source identity
      calculationId - attempted calculation UUID
      sequence - session sequence
      simulationTimeS - last coherent simulation time in s
      generatedAt - UTC generation instant
      status - INVALID, UNSUPPORTED, STALE or DISABLED
      code - stable diagnostic code
      message - failure or lifecycle explanation
      provenance - process metadata
      Returns:
      immutable frame with no source payload

    • withLocation

      public SourceTermFrame withLocation(String referenceFrame, double[] positionM, double[] direction)
      Adds explicit source coordinates without changing the receiver.
      Parameters:
      referenceFrame - coordinate-system identifier, including origin/axis convention
      positionM - three Cartesian coordinates in m
      direction - three components of a unit direction vector
      Returns:
      frame with location and a recomputed fingerprint
